name: grid-clipboard
title: Grid Clipboard
description: The spreadsheet clipboard as data: parse TSV, clipboard HTML and Google Sheets' typed values into a cell matrix; write TSV and HTML for a copied range; fit a paste to a selected range.

meta.whenToUse: Copy and paste between a grid and spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers, Airtable) — DataGrid's cells mode, or a host's own paste preview or import.
meta.whenNotToUse: CSV files (a CSV parser), or rich text paste into an editor.
